summary: Iteration 2 (Drive Restore, Whisper voice notes, ICD-10 autocomplete, Follow-up overdue, media sub-headings). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass — health, upload/download, patient CRUD, media persistence, no _id leak, plus new TestDiagnosis (diagnosis field persists via POST + GET without ObjectId leak) and TestTranscribe (empty audio -> 400; 0.5s silence WAV -> 200 with `text` key). Frontend (mobile 375x667): dashboard shows 'Follow-up Overdue' filter chip that filters to overdue-only patients; orange 'Follow-up overdue • Nd' pill renders on qualifying cards; header shows overdue count. Add-Patient ICD-10 autocomplete opens on typing 'osteo' with 6 M16/M17 options, tapping fills 'CODE - Label' into input-diagnosis. Sub-headings 'Images', 'Documents' render in both Pre-op and Post-op sections; 'Videos' heading in Videos section; all buttons present: pre_op-add-image, pre_op-add-doc, post_op-add-image, post_op-add-doc, add-video-btn, voice-note-btn. Settings shows Google Drive card with 'not configured' setup-helper listing all three EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_* env keys (as expected — client IDs empty).

issues: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' from RN Web — cosmetic, unchanged from iter 1.

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow across styles (still noisy in console — same as iter 1).
Optional: FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown are deprecated — consider moving object-storage init to a lifespan context manager.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /transcribe correctly returns controlled 400 (empty), 413 (>25MiB), 502 (whisper failure) and 200 with {text: string} — good boundary handling.
MongoDB projections consistently use {'_id': 0}; verified no ObjectId leakage in list/detail responses including new diagnosis field.

src/utils/followup.ts isOverdue() treats 'no result OR no post_op' as overdue after 42 days — matches spec that dashboard filter needs date_of_surgery > 42d ago AND result empty; also flags patients with results but no post-op media, which may be intentional but worth verifying with product.
src/utils/voice.ts uses expo-audio (correct, not deprecated expo-av) — good.
src/data/icd10.ts searchIcd() has an early-break at starts.length >= limit which can miss high-quality 'contains' matches — minor UX detail, still works for spec's 'osteo' case (6 relevant results).
add-patient.tsx ICD dropdown is inline (not modal) with keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' — good, no tap-through issues observed.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Overdue_Case patient (date_of_surgery=2024-01-01, empty result) via /api/patients to validate overdue filter/pill — DELETED after UI verification. TestDiagnosis class also cleans its TEST_Diag_Persist row in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: https://surgical-vault-2.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. /transcribe accepts multipart form 'file' — validated with 0.5s 8kHz 16-bit mono silence WAV built via wave stdlib; Whisper returned 200 with (possibly empty) text. To seed an overdue card: POST /api/patients with date_of_surgery in the past (>42d) and empty result, then reload /dashboard and tap sort-chip-overdue. Google Drive OAuth is intentionally not configured (env IDs empty) — settings shows setup helper instead of connect button; do not OAuth-test.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
